body: The TC-001 check says "`git diff master` on `technical.md` touches only that sentence in the entry". The actual diff on `technical.md` also changes line 4 ("FR-RESPONSIVE-001 to 027" becomes "001 to 030") and adds the issue #200 section (lines 219-236). Run as written, this check fails on the correct change. TC-003 in testcases.md already allows "traceability lines that cite issue #200 or FR-RESPONSIVE-028 to 030". Suggested fix: reword the sentence as "within the TS-RESPONSIVE-017 entry, `git diff master` touches only that sentence", so it matches TC-001's scope ("the rest of the entry is unchanged") and TC-003.

The new sentence is correct against `src/index.css` (lines 686-704). The sentence before it, "Flex line breaking puts each cell on the current line when its max-content width fits", is still not exact for the item cell. Because of `flex: 1 1 14rem`, the item cell's flex base size is 14rem, not its max-content width, so line breaking uses 14rem for that cell. FR-RESPONSIVE-028 and TC-001 require the rest of the entry to stay unchanged, so do not edit it in this PR. Suggested follow-up issue: qualify the sentence, for example "each cell (the item cell from its 14rem basis) ...", so the paragraph has no other mismatch with TS-RESPONSIVE-023.
